title: Explore

## Study data

This page lets visitors explore **published research data** from a randomized controlled trial of youth male soccer players. The study compared a 12-week plyometric jump training program with a control group and categorized players by estimated maturity status before or after peak height velocity (PHV). No new participant data were collected for this project.

For each participant and test, I averaged the available attempts before and after the intervention. The table contains paired values for nine performance tests. Its A01–A37 labels are temporary row labels created for filtering; the source dataset does not identify participants by name or ID. For sprint, L-run, and drop-jump contact time, lower values indicate faster performance. Other measures are shown in their recorded units.

## Interactive performance graph

Use the dropdowns to filter the graph and table by test, training group, and participant. Hover over or keyboard-focus a participant's line or point to see their before, after, and change values.

## Searchable data table

The dropdown filters above also apply to this table. Search within the currently selected rows by athlete label, test, group, or maturity.

<div class="table-search">

</div>
